decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable, high-quality daily backpack. My consideration set includes the QT&QY tactical bag (prod_backpacks_057), the Maxpedition EDC bag (prod_backpacks_038), the FORICH cooler bag (prod_backpacks_194), a red hiking daypack (prod_backpacks_101), and the Sojourner hydration pack (prod_backpacks_126). While the tactical bag (prod_backpacks_057) offers great value, it is too niche for my daily needs. The Maxpedition bag (prod_backpacks_038) is the style I want but feels expensive for its features. The only standard daypack (prod_backpacks_101) has concerning reviews about strap durability. Many other items in the feed were irrelevant (umbrellas, tents, food), so I have decided not to make a purchase during this session until I can find a more durable general-purpose backpack.
